Neem Karoli Baba's daughter watched 'Hanuman Ansh' film 15 times

Ragani Sona, producer of the film 'Hanuman Ansh', stated that Girija Ji (Amma Ji), daughter of Neem Karoli Baba, watched the film 15 times. Sona also mentioned a miracle that occurred before the film was made, which left her astonished. News18 Hindi reported that Girija Ji felt as if Baba himself was present while watching the film.
